suites.name: cunit
notes: Make check alone does not run this executable. Main returns zero independently of the summary, so the final assertion/failure summary was inspected.

suites.name: googletest
notes: FooTest.Bar and the three gtest_skip_test cases deliberately test skip/environment behavior. PrintStlContainerTest.StdSpan is unavailable because this build lacks the C++20 std::span path.
Disabled counts are self-test fixtures; the 13-case set is reported in both normal and no-RTTI test executables. Do not sum them as distinct product omissions.

Stress and repeat self-tests intentionally print FAILED; their main functions assert that the expected failure occurred and return success. No unexpected wrapper failures were reported. Internal pass totals are not aggregated because these self-tests deliberately repeat and fail test bodies.

suites.name: geos
notes: XMLTester.cpp:711-717 prints skipped and returns when fixture geometry parsing raises; neither skipped case reaches its geometric assertion. These are not deliberate profile omissions and no source/expectations were edited.

unavailable.cause: Extra closing parenthesis at line 59; ParseException: Unexpected text after end of geometry.

suites.name: curl
notes: Corrected rerun uses active linked-list, base64, timeout, DNS-cache/hash, and splay-tree bodies. Dummy URL is not transferred. unit1305 dummy argument differs from 1305 and therefore executes the node-allocation/hash-insertion branch.
Original 0051-curl-unit1307.log is historical omitted coverage: FTP-disabled build compiled an empty test body. It is superseded by the active unit1303 rerun, not counted among final five.
HTTP-only debug-enabled libcurl. Full server/protocol suite and real HTTP transfers were not tested; TLS/HTTPS is disabled. Socket denial is enforced by parent build runner.

suites.name: proj
notes: The 12 early-return cases remain in reported GTest pass counts; they are not GTEST_SKIP events. Local simulated callbacks and disabled-network behavior still execute.

All 11 YAML wrappers now run with retained PyYAML. Historical run001 cached configure omitted them; clean run002 failed the CURL-free --remote-data expectation; current run003 passes unchanged tests with compiled curl API.
Real proj.db and retained source grid fixtures are used; does not establish all CRS/grid coverage.

suites.name: gdal
notes: Correct GDAL_ENABLE_DRIVER_RAW=ON enables EHdr and ENVI; runtime driver list confirms both. Earlier invalid EHDR flag was not an accepted feature option.
CSV data file exists; the two cannot-open skips are caused by deliberately disabled CSV driver, not missing archive data.

Four block-cache test variants execute with 32 threads and pass; DEBUG_CONTENTION performance instrumentation is unavailable in this release build (port/cpl_multiproc.cpp:48). This does not skip their cache correctness checks.
Remaining 31 GTest skips match the bounded feature profile. Python bindings/Python autotest suite are disabled/unrun; results describe selected native C++ tests.
